apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.4.2 — SequencePlayer migration Phase P-C: phrases (Compose list + editor, LoopLab Swaras section + editor) now play through the shared SequencePlayer core via a thin PhraseAdapter. Same notes, durations, +0.4 s loop breath and host highlighting; the highlight now comes from the unified ticker instead of per-chip timers. Ear-test gates: a phrase loop in the foreground and locked (two to three passes); section and editor hosts do not cross-highlight.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Phrases migrate to the shared SequencePlayer (P-C).
